/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:1/div:0/p:2/text:22: At Fair Go Work Advocates we provide clear, practical employment advice. We take the complexity and stress out of employment issues so you can move forward with confidence.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:2/div:0/div:1/h2:1/text:26: A firm built on trust and expertise
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:2/div:0/div:1/p:2/text:27: Our advocates have been supporting 'the little guy' for over 20 years. Our team of employment law specialists bring a wealth of knowledge across all employment issues.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:2/div:0/div:1/p:3/text:28: We believe the law should work for you — not the other way around. That's why we take the time to understand your situation and provide advice that is clear, honest, and effective.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:3/div:0/div:1/div:0/p:2/text:38: Facing a disciplinary meeting can be stressful. We can help you understand your rights and prepare for the process.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:3/div:0/div:1/div:1/p:2/text:41: Workplace bullying is serious and unlawful. You don't have to endure it. We can help you take action.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:3/div:0/div:1/div:2/p:2/text:44: Discrimination based on protected characteristics is unlawful. We help you understand your rights and pursue remedies.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:3/div:0/div:1/div:3/p:2/text:47: If you've been dismissed unfairly, you may have grounds for a personal grievance. We can help you take action.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:3/div:0/div:1/div:4/p:2/text:50: When employers breach employment agreements, you have rights. We help you understand your options and recover what's owed.
/preview/3gajz8K2CD7WS2NwFw82vsrm.section:3/div:0/div:1/div:5/p:2/text:53: Being dismissed due to illness or medical condition is often unlawful. We help you understand your rights and take action.
